description: Thirty customer messages from the bookkeeper at Acme Studios about several invoices, then a follow-up that refers back to turn 2.
messages: Hi, I'm the bookkeeper at Acme Studios, not the owner.
Invoice INV-4471 was flagged as overdue and I don't understand why. Can you look it up?
What is the total on that one?
When was it due?
Our client says they paid it on March 3rd. Does Ledgerly show a payment?
OK. Is there a late fee on it already?
How is the late fee calculated?
And when does a late fee start to apply?
Can a late fee be waived if the invoice is disputed?
Please look up INV-4438 as well.
How many days overdue is INV-4438?
Is that one older than INV-4471?
What late fee would apply to INV-4438?
Can you open a support ticket about the payment for INV-4471?
What is the ticket number?
Which email address will the replies go to?
Our billing contact is billing@acme.example, please use that.
How do I record a payment manually in Ledgerly?
Can I attach a bank confirmation to the invoice?
What payment methods can my clients use?
Can I set up a payment plan for an overdue invoice?
Does a payment plan stop late fees?
How do I send a reminder to a client?
Can reminders be scheduled automatically?
What happens to a late fee if the invoice is paid in full?
Can I export my overdue invoices?
Which invoices do I have that are overdue right now?
Is there a limit on how many invoices I can have on my plan?
How do I change the plan for Acme Studios?
Thanks, that's all for the invoices.
followUp: Going back to the first invoice I mentioned, is that one sorted now?
